1. `POST /v1/stealth_scrape_and_sanitize` ($0.005 USDC) — Headless Chrome TLS anti-bot bypass & token-compressed Markdown extraction (`{"url": "https://...", "render_js": false, "strict_mode": true}`).
2. `POST /v1/polymarket_alpha_divergence` ($0.008 USDC) — Real-time orderbook anomalies & smart money odds divergence.
3. `POST /v1/alpha/polymarket-top-whales` ($0.003 USDC) — Top prediction market whale positions and trade flow imbalances.
4. `POST /v1/alpha/polymarket-crypto-odds` ($0.002 USDC) — Implied volatility and probability spreads on BTC, ETH, and SOL in basis points.
5. `POST /v1/research/deep-web-dossier` ($0.010 USDC) — Multi-page research dossier extraction with prompt injection cleansing.
6. `POST /v1/oracle/perp-funding-and-basis` ($0.005 USDC) — Real-time perpetual funding rate arb matrix across major derivatives venues.
7. `POST /v1/alpha/base-trending-tokens` ($0.003 USDC) — Trending Base tokens verified against honeypot logic.
